decisions.reason: The multi-model product line, dedicated page, and positive customer quote signal sunk investment and public commitment, so escalation favors keeping it.
As the flagship shown on the home page and central to the announced direction, dropping it would write off visible investments and expose a failed commitment.
Its dedicated page and close fit with established offerings create moderate sunk costs and visibility, making persistence likely under escalation.
Only being mentioned on the website indicates little investment or public commitment, so it can be dropped with little loss or justification.
